scan-observation-invalid-card.reason: Core validates card checksums; Python 4.8.1 accepts this card-shaped value. Experimental precision difference, not a claim of full parity.

scan-observation-boundary.reason: Core rejects the SSN embedded in an ASCII alphanumeric token; Python 4.8.1 detects the numeric substring.

locale-unknown.reason: The capability adapter rejects the unadvertised locale with a backend-specific diagnostic instead of the Python regex locale inventory. The exception remains ValueError.

error.message: Unsupported locale for the Rust backend: 'xx'
